snippet.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Cost of Hope — Release Date Reveal
snippet.description:
The gates to the center are sealed tighter than ever — but as it goes in the Zone, the most cunning already know when the right chance will appear.
Whispers around the campfires speak of August 20. S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Cost of Hope expansion arrives, and now is the time to get ready for a new expedition deep into the Zone!
Discover twisted stories of Duty and Freedom, explore previously forbidden lands of Iron Forest and CNPP, and face the intrigue of powers far greater than any lone stalker.
The video contains 2 audio tracks.

Wishlist now:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3765020/STALKER_2_Cost_of_Hope/
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/stalker-2-cost-of-hope/9mxv6p2fnddc
PlayStation 5: https://www.playstation.com/games/stalker-2-heart-of-chornobyl 
GOG: https://www.gog.com/game/stalker_2_cost_of_hope
